claims: Cori Close is the head coach of the UCLA Women's Basketball team.
Cori Close has held the position of head coach of the UCLA Women's Basketball team since April 2011.
Cori Close is known as the Michael Price Family UCLA Women's Head Basketball Coach.
Cori Close has led the UCLA Women's Basketball team to over 300 career wins.
Cori Close led the UCLA Women's Basketball team to a 2025 Final Four appearance.
Cori Close was named head coach on April 21, 2011.
Cori Close led the UCLA Women's Basketball team to their first NCAA Final Four in the 2024-25 season.
Cori Close led the UCLA Women's Basketball team to a No. 1 ranking in the 2024-25 season.
Cori Close was named the WBCA NCAA Division I Coach of the Year for the 2024-25 season.
As of March 2026, Cori Close has expressed fatigue regarding the evolving challenges of modern college sports.
As of March 2026, Cori Close remains the active leader of the UCLA Women's Basketball team.
For the 2025-26 season, Cori Close is Head Coach of the UCLA Women's Basketball team.
For the 2025-26 season, Tony Newnan is Associate Head Coach of the UCLA Women's Basketball team.
For the 2025-26 season, Tasha Brown is Assistant Coach of the UCLA Women's Basketball team.
For the 2025-26 season, Soh Matsuura is Assistant Coach of the UCLA Women's Basketball team.
For the 2025-26 season, James Clark is Assistant Coach of the UCLA Women's Basketball team.
For the 2025-26 season, Michaela Onyenwere is Assistant Coach of the UCLA Women's Basketball team.
